headline: Cyclone Arnab Completes Landfall on Andhra Pradesh Coast
deck: The very severe storm crossed near Narsapur after at least 180,000 people were evacuated; coastal districts reported damage and disruption.
body: Cyclone Arnab made landfall on India’s east coast as a very severe cyclonic storm, Al Jazeera reported, bringing heavy rain and winds of up to 135 kph. [E1] [E2]
At least 180,000 people were evacuated from Andhra Pradesh and Odisha a day earlier, Al Jazeera reported. [E3]
The landfall was approximately 20 km east-northeast of Narsapur, 40 km southwest of Yanam and 60 km southwest of Kakinada, India Today reported. [E4]
The Times of India reported that the storm uprooted trees and electric poles, disrupted power supply and communications, and damaged roads and standing crops across coastal districts. [E5]
